name: Modem Component
description: The `modem` component connects an ESP32 to the internet through a cellular modem attached to a UART. The modem carries the traffic over PPP, so the [API](https://esphome.io/components/api/), [MQTT](https://esphome.io/components/mqtt/) and OTA updates work as they do over Wi-Fi or Ethernet.

config_entries.label: Update Interval
config_entries.description: How often the [Modem Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/modem/) and the `network_type` [Modem Text Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/text_sensor/modem/) query the modem while it is connected, at least `10s`. Defaults to `60s`.

config_entries.label: Model
config_entries.description: The modem model, one of `BG96`, `SIM800`, `SIM7000`, `SIM7070`, `SIM7080`, `SIM7600`, `SIM7670` or `GENERIC`. `GENERIC` drives a modem that is not listed with the standard AT commands. Every modem, `GENERIC` included, must support CMUX (3GPP TS 27.010), which the component uses to keep AT commands working while the data link is up.

config_entries.label: Apn
config_entries.description: The Access Point Name (APN) of your cellular operator.

config_entries.label: Cts Pin
config_entries.description:
**Set together — all of these must be set, or all left blank:** `rts_pin`, `cts_pin`.

The `CTS` pin for hardware flow control. Must be set together with `rts_pin`.

config_entries.label: Mode
config_entries.description: Pin mode flags (input / output / pullup / pulldown / open_drain). Combine flags as needed — e.g. input + pullup for a button pulled to VCC.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.

config_entries.label: Baud Rate
config_entries.description: The baud rate to run the link at. The component first finds the rate the modem answers at (the last rate that worked, this one, then `115200`), then asks the modem to switch to `baud_rate`. Defaults to the rate the modem answers at.

config_entries.label: Dte Buffer Size
config_entries.description: The size of the modem library's command buffer in bytes. Increase it if the log shows `CMUX: Failed to defragment longer payload`. Defaults to `1024`.

config_entries.label: Enable On Boot
config_entries.description: Whether to connect the modem when the device starts. Set this to `false` when the modem has to be powered on first, then use the `modem.enable` action. Defaults to `true`.

config_entries.label: Init At
config_entries.description: AT commands to send once the modem answers, before it attaches to the network, each up to 127 characters. Each result is logged, and a failed command is shown in the component's status, also while connected, until a later attempt runs it without failure.

config_entries.label: Pin Code
config_entries.description: The PIN of the SIM card, 4 to 8 digits. It is sent at most twice, counted across reboots, without the SIM reporting that it is unlocked, so a wrong PIN stops the modem instead of locking the SIM. A PIN the SIM refuses uses up both sends at once. Once the SIM reports that it is unlocked, the count starts again from zero. A changed `pin_code` also starts from zero. To clear the count for the same PIN, remove `pin_code`, flash once, and add it back.

config_entries.label: Reboot Timeout
config_entries.description: How long the device may stay without a connection before it reboots. Set to `0s` to never reboot. Defaults to `10min`.

config_entries.label: RX Buffer Size
config_entries.description: The size of the UART receive buffer in bytes, from `129` to `65535`. Defaults to `1024`.

config_entries.label: TX Buffer Size
config_entries.description: The size of the UART transmit buffer in bytes, from `129` to `65535`. Defaults to `1024`.

config_entries.label: Use Address
config_entries.description: The address the ESPHome tools use to reach the device, for example for OTA updates and logs. Defaults to `<name>.local`.
